title: Risk diversification for infinitely divisible distributions
summary: In this paper, we study the diversification properties of convex combinations of iid infinitely divisible random variables. For Lévy processes with bounded variation sample paths, we characterize, in terms of subadditivity and concavity of the transformed Lévy tails, Lévy processes that exhibit the non-diversification phenomenon or the reverse diversification order with respect to the majorization order uniformly over all time horizons.
